mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role(role_name, role_key,sort, remark,status,delete_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{roleName},#{roleKey},#{sort},#{remark},#{status},#{deleteFlag},#{createTime},#{updateTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM sys_role
AND role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
AND delete_flag = 0
ORDER BY create_time ASC, sort ASC
SELECT id,role_name,role_key FROM sys_role ORDER BY create_time ASC, sort ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_role WHERE delete_flag = 1 ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
